title: From Momentary Emotion Inference to Sustained Emotion Support: Evaluating a Companion Agent in a Longitudinal Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.16344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sustained emotional support is a long-horizon interaction task closely tied to human well-being. Recent research demonstrates generative agents' capacity for momentary emotional support, yet how these capabilities sustain support over time remains unclear. To examine this challenge, we deployed PAIR, a theory-based emotion-regulation companion, with 19 participants for 14 days. Across 1,093 sessions, we paired emotion estimates with self-reports before and after guidance and analyzed logs and interviews. Estimates corresponded more closely to self-reported valence and dominance than arousal. Guided conversations were followed by higher valence and state-dependent arousal changes. Participants felt understood through contextual exploration and emotional acknowledgment, acting on guidance suited to their needs and constraints. Perceived helpfulness of guided conversation significantly increased over time. Our findings link memory updates

translated_title: 从瞬时情绪推断到持续情感支持：一项纵向研究中陪伴智能体的评估
translated_abstract: 持续情感支持是一项与人类幸福感密切相关的长时程交互任务。近期研究表明生成式智能体具备提供瞬时情感支持的能力，但这些能力如何在长期中维持支持仍不清楚。为探究这一挑战，我们将PAIR——一个基于理论的情绪调节陪伴智能体——与19名参与者共同部署了14天。在1,093次会话中，我们将情绪估计与引导前后的自我报告进行配对，并分析了系统日志和访谈。结果显示，情绪估计与自我报告的效价和支配度的对应程度高于唤醒度。引导式对话之后，参与者的效价提升更明显，并出现依赖状态的唤醒度变化。参与者通过情境探索和情感确认感到被理解，并能根据自身需求和约束采取相应的引导行动。引导式对话的感知有用性随时间显著提升。我们的发现将记忆更新与……
tldr: 该研究通过14天的纵向部署验证了基于情绪调节理论的陪伴智能体PAIR不仅能准确推断用户情绪，还能在长期交互中提供日益有用的持续情感支持，实现了从瞬时情绪支持到持续情感支持的跨越。
en_tdlr: Through a 14-day longitudinal deployment of PAIR, a theory-based emotion-regulation companion agent, this study demonstrates that generative agents can extend beyond momentary emotion inference to provide sustained emotional support, with perceived helpfulness significantly increasing over time.
